name: Question 11
problem:
A man stocked a pond with $250$ fish. After $t$ weeks, the number of fish in the pond is given by the function 

$$
F(t)=250+{\int }_{0}^{t}(8x-24)\,\text{d}x,
$$

where $t>0$ is the time (in weeks) since the man put the fish in the pond.

At what time is the number of fish in the pond at a minimum, and how many fish are there at that time?

Question 11
?

A man stocked a pond with 250 fish. After t weeks, the number of fish in the pond is given by the function F(t)=250+∫0t(8x−24)dx, where t>0 is the time (in weeks) since the man put the fish in the pond.

At what time is the number of fish in the pond at a minimum, and how many fish are there at that time?

a
The minimum is 230 fish after 5 weeks
b
The minimum is 218 fish after 2 weeks
c
The minimum is 230 fish after 1 week
d
The minimum is 215 fish after 4 weeks
e
The minimum is 214 fish after 3 weeks
